interpretation: Target-conditioned posterior reconstruction is not a predictive forecast; on these already-consumed teacher-source episodes, it and teacher-forced one-step prior are near the true-previous-frame repeat baseline.

For the same two teacher-trained seeds, 32-decision free-running prior error exceeds frozen-anchor repeat and worsens with additional model-only updates even though raw same-transition categorical KL falls. This localizes a descriptive divergence to unobserved multi-step rollout, not a proved causal loss or architecture defect.

The one-step posterior baseline sees the true previous frame while the 32-decision repeat baseline persists only the window anchor. Their different information sets must not be compared as if they were the same counterfactual policy.
With only four independent road episodes per action stratum and no development finish positives, neither a student driving result nor terminal/finish prediction generalization can be inferred.
A bounded multi-step prior image-consistency loss is a prospective hypothesis requiring new source-pinned code, contract tests and a separate frozen training protocol before any new model update.
